_comment: Client-side Talent.dbc overrides for REAL class talent tabs (Enhancement 263, Retribution 381, ...) - distinct from eq_talent_pack.json, which only ever touches the drafted-pool tab (TabID 0). Consumed by tools/build_client_patch.py, which reads the native Talent.dbc (--dbc-src), applies each entry below as a full-row replace-or-add, deletes every id in `removals`, and packs the result into patch-P.mpq as DBFilesClient\Talent.dbc.

The server's own gating (Player::LearnTalent -> sTalentStore) already reads straight from the acore_world.talent_dbc SQL table (DBCStorageBase::LoadFromDB replaces/adds each row by ID after the physical file loads, confirmed in src/server/shared/DataStores/DBCStore.cpp) - this manifest exists purely so the STOCK BLIZZARD TALENT FRAME (primary-class UI, which reads the client's own Talent.dbc, not the server) shows the same tree. See .agents/docs/systems/talents.md.

IMPORTANT: removing a talent here (or from acore_world.talent_dbc) while a character still has it in acore_characters.character_talent makes Player::_LoadTalents ASSERT and kill the worldserver on that character's next login - ship the matching character_talent DELETE in the same change. See .agents/plans/melee-talent-rework/.
_row_format: [ID, TabID, TierID, ColumnIndex, SpellRank_1, SpellRank_2, SpellRank_3, SpellRank_4, SpellRank_5, SpellRank_6, SpellRank_7, SpellRank_8, SpellRank_9, PrereqTalent_1, PrereqTalent_2, PrereqTalent_3, PrereqRank_1, PrereqRank_2, PrereqRank_3, Flags, RequiredSpellID, CategoryMask_1, CategoryMask_2] - 23 fields, exactly acore_world.talent_dbc's column order. Every entry must supply all 23; there is no partial-field patching (DBCStorageBase::LoadFromDB replaces the whole record by ID, and this tool mirrors that same all-or-nothing semantics).
